text:
sasha_sales: SilverGate Health sent a presales packet. They want a 3-week POC: SAML SSO (Okta/Azure), SCIM provisioning (bulk + deltas) for ~150k directory objects, delegated admin across regional tenants, RBAC mapping (~10 roles including dynamic attrs), private VPC connector with mTLS preferred, and BYOK/KMS. They also asked for audit-log immutability for 7 years on select events and a signed BAA before any PHI. Can SE confirm blockers & a ballpark?
ravi_se: Feels doable. Quick calls-out: 1) SCIM over mTLS is Private-only; hosted SCIM uses bearer tokens. 2) For 150k objects do initial bulk import + incremental deltas (we recommend 5m cadence). 3) Delegated admin requires domain ownership proof per tenant (DNS TXT preferred or signed SAML assertion). 4) Hosted plan rate limits exist; Dedicated/Private removes common throttles.
marta_security: Compliance notes: HIPAA + HITRUST likely. BAA required before PHI or PII in logs. BYOK supported for Private; keys remain in customer KMS (we store envelope-wrapped keys only). Draft answer for questionnaire: "Customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments; keys remain under customer control and are not exported by Redwood. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer S3 or SIEM; immutability can be achieved via S3 Object Lock or customer WORM storage."
tom_soleng: POC checklist for customer (minimal):
- IdP SAML metadata (cert, entityID, ACS, SingleLogout)
- SCIM service account + mTLS client cert (if Private)
- RBAC mapping file (CSV: group_external_id,group_name,assigned_role)
- sample group->role rows (eg: "claims-admins,Claims Admins,claims_admin")
- domain verification access (DNS or assertion)
- network allowlist + proxy details
- KMS details + signed BAA

Sample SCIM PATCH we use in POC:
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "Replace",
    "path": "roles",
    "value": ["clinical_viewer","claims_admin"]
  }]
}

SAML ACS for POC: https://poc.silvergate.redwood.example/saml/acs (RelayState supported). Certificate rotation: we support hot-swap with overlap window to avoid downtime.
ravi_se: Ballpark POC pricing (3 weeks, Private staging + connector + SE support): Private staging (prorated) $24k, connector & install $10k, SE/runbook/support $6k -> total ~$40k. If they require full air-gapped on-prem inference nodes add ~$45k. Finance/legal will need to sign off.
sasha_sales: I'll ask SilverGate for SAML metadata, sample RBAC CSV, expected delta rate, and whether they insist on air-gap. They're aiming for an April window. Will post replies here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ticket RED-49999 created for SilverGate POC (owner: ravi_se) - https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-49999
marta_security: Two additional caveats to surface in the questionnaire: 1) SCIM conflict resolution across delegated admins needs a source-of-truth policy (we recommend IdP wins or provide deterministic merge rules), 2) Air-gapped/on-prem inference reduces telemetry (trace sampling, live evals) — call that out.
sasha_sales: Perfect. I'll send the questionnaire and loop legal for BAA. Thanks all!
